info.title: Auto.dev Vehicle Data API
info.description:
Access comprehensive vehicle data including listings, specifications, and market intelligence from U.S. physical & online dealers.

## Authentication
Send your API key as `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`, or as the `apiKey` query parameter. Create keys at https://www.auto.dev/dashboard/api-keys. A call without a valid key gets a 401.

## Plans and rate limits
- Free: 5 requests per second, 1,000 API calls per month
- Growth: 10 requests per second
- Scale: 50 requests per second

An operation that needs a higher plan carries `x-required-plan` and answers 402 to a key below it. Over the rate limit, a call gets a 429 with a `Retry-After` header.

## Errors
Every error is JSON with the HTTP `status`. The full catalog is at https://docs.auto.dev/v2/reference/errors. A 207 is a partial answer, not an error.

get.description: Decode a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) to retrieve comprehensive vehicle information including make, model, year, and validation details.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number

200.description: Successfully decoded VIN with vehicle information

207.description: Partial answer: the public decoders name less than the year, make and model, and the vehicle's class or market says why. `vehicle` holds what was said (manufacturer, type, year; make and model when named); the decode fields of a 200 are absent. Not an error, not billed. Branch on the status before reading the body as a 200.

example.error: VIN must be exactly 17 characters containing only letters and numbers (excluding I, O, Q)
No vehicle data found for the provided VIN

get.description: Get comprehensive vehicle listings from U.S. physical & online dealers. Returns an array of listings with detailed vehicle information, dealership data, specifications, and market pricing.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve (starting from 1)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of listings to return per page. Maximum 500. Per-plan caps (Free/Starter: 20, Growth: 100, Scale: 500) will be enforced in a future release; callers will be emailed before the change ships.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token. Issued by the API in links.next at page 50+. Conflicts with ?page= — pick one mode. Follow the emitted cursor URL rather than constructing manually.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field with optional direction. Format: <field> or <field>.<direction>. Supported fields: createdAt, updatedAt, price, miles, mileage, year. Direction: asc or desc (default asc). Default when omitted: updatedAt.desc. Single field only; multi-column sort, random, and distance are not supported.

parameters.name: vehicle.year
parameters.description: The year of the vehicle. Use specific year (2018) or range (2018-2020)

parameters.name: vehicle.make
parameters.description: Vehicle manufacturer. Use comma for multiple: Ford,Chevrolet

parameters.name: vehicle.model
parameters.description: Vehicle model. Use comma for multiple: F-150,Silverado

parameters.name: vehicle.trim
parameters.description: Trim level. Use comma for multiple: XLT,LT

parameters.name: vehicle.bodyStyle
parameters.description: Body style. Use comma for multiple: sedan,coupe

parameters.name: vehicle.engine
parameters.description: Engine size. Use comma for multiple: 2.0L,3.5L

parameters.name: vehicle.transmission
parameters.description: Transmission type. Use comma for multiple: automatic,manual

parameters.name: vehicle.interiorColor
parameters.description: Exterior color. Use comma for multiple: white,black

parameters.name: vehicle.exteriorColor
parameters.description: Exterior color. Use comma for multiple: white,black

parameters.name: vehicle.doors
parameters.description: Number of doors (2, 4, 5)

parameters.name: retailListing.price
parameters.description: Vehicle price. Use range: 10000-20000

parameters.name: retailListing.state
parameters.description: State where vehicle is located (e.g., CA)

parameters.name: retailListing.miles
parameters.description: Vehicle mileage. Use range: 10000-20000

parameters.name: retailListing.used
parameters.description: Used vs new. `true` for used vehicles, `false` for new.

parameters.name: retailListing.cpo
parameters.description: Certified Pre-Owned flag. `true` filters to CPO listings.

parameters.name: vehicle.fuel
parameters.description: Fuel type. Use comma for multiple: Gasoline,Hybrid,Electric,Plug-In Hybrid,Diesel.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit ZIP code to center the search around. Pair with `distance` for radius search.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Radius in miles from the `zip` ZIP code to include in results.

parameters.name: dealerId
parameters.description: Dealer ID as returned in `retailListing.dealerId`. Filter by it to return all listings for that dealer. Use comma for multiple.

parameters.name: dealerZip
parameters.description: ZIP code(s) the dealer is located in. Distinct from the top-level `zip` (buyer-center for radius search). Use comma for multiple.

parameters.name: includeUnpriced
parameters.description: Opt in to listings with `retailListing.price = null`. Off by default; zero/null-price rows are filtered out unless set to `true`.

parameters.name: includes
parameters.description: Opt-in response extensions. `total` adds `"total": <number>` (matching rows ignoring pagination). `facets` adds a `"facets": {...}` object with bucketed counts and drill-down URLs per filterable dimension. Pass either or both as a comma-separated list; order is not significant (`?includes=total,facets` and `?includes=facets,total` are equivalent).

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of field paths to project, e.g. `vehicle.vin,vehicle.year,retailListing.price`. Nested fields require dot notation (`vehicle.vin`, not `vin`); top-level fields without a nested equivalent (`createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `location`) use their bare name. When set, `data[]` rows come back with flat dot-keyed properties (e.g. `"vehicle.year": 2025`) rather than the nested objects of the default response. Omit to receive the full default response.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: 17-character VIN to filter on as a query parameter. Equivalent to the `/listings/{vin}` path form but returns an array wrapper instead of a single-listing wrapper.

data.summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2019 Porsche 911 Speedster, 2020 Porsche 911 Carrera S Coupe, Carrera 4S Coupe, and Carrera S Cabriolet vehicles. The screw connection on the rear axle upper control arm may be loose.
data.consequence: A loose connection may fail, causing driving instability and increasing the risk of a crash.
data.remedy: Porsche will notify owners, and dealers will rework and tighten the screw connection on the rear axle upper control arm, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 21, 2021. Owners may contact Porsche customer service at 1-800-767-7243. Porsche's number for this recall is AMA6.
data.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

207.description: Partial answer: the VIN decodes to a car but no record builds it. `build` is null; `vehicle` names the car, `catalog` is what the matched style ships with (or null), `reason` says why. Not an error, not billed. Branch on the status or on `build === null` before reading `build`.

400.description: Invalid VIN format or VIN decode failed

error.error: VIN must be exactly 17 characters containing only letters and numbers (excluding I, O, Q)

404.description: We could not name the car: no decoder answered (`VIN_NOT_FOUND`), the VIN is not a vehicle (`INVALID_VIN`), or it is outside coverage with no decode (`VIN_NOT_IN_COVERAGE`). A car we can name but cannot build answers 207 instead. Every miss carries `reason` and `retryable`.

error.error: No build data available for this vehicle.

get.description: Get currently active and unresolved vehicle recall information from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) database. This API filters out completed, closed, or resolved recalls to show only those requiring immediate attention or repair action.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number to retrieve open recalls for

parameters.name: recalls
parameters.description: When `true`, the response includes an additional `recalls` array carrying the full make/model/year recall catalog, including remedied campaigns, alongside the open-only `data` array. It lists each campaign once, plus any of the VIN's open recalls whose campaign the catalog does not list. Catalog records use the field names of `data` records but carry only what the catalog supplies (no `mfrCampaignNumber`, `remedyAvailable`, `mfrNotes` or `isSafetyRecall`); an open recall added from `data` appears as it does there. When no catalog is available, `recalls` holds only the VIN's open recalls, and is an empty array if there are none.

data.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Explorer vehicles.  The powertrain control module (PCM) may reset while driving, which can damage the park system or cause an engine stall.
data.consequence: A damaged park system can result in a vehicle rollaway when the vehicle is placed in park without the parking brake applied.  An engine stall while driving can result in a sudden loss of drive power.  Either of these scenarios can increase the risk of a crash.
data.remedy: Dealers will update the powertrain control module software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 6, 2025. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 25S35.
data.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236 (TTY 888-275-9171) or go to nhtsa.gov.

manufacturerCampaigns.summary: Customer Satisfaction Program: a front-camera calibration fault may affect certain 2025 Explorer vehicles. This is a manufacturer program, not a NHTSA safety recall, so it is listed here and not counted in openRecalls.
manufacturerCampaigns.remedy: Dealers will recalibrate the front camera at no charge.

error.error: VIN must be exactly 17 characters containing only letters and numbers (excluding I, O, Q)

Ambiguity.name: ambiguity
Ambiguity.description: Whether to allow a best-guess answer for a VIN that matches several styles. By default (false) the answer does not guess: style is null, trim is null unless our sources settle it (specs is null on /specs), and trims and styles list the possibilities. true allows a single best-guess pick. Also accepted as the X-Ambiguity header.

bearerAuth.description: Use your API key in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`

queryString.name: apiKey
queryString.description: Use your API key as a query parameter: `?apiKey=YOUR_API_KEY`

squishVin.description: 10-character squish VIN (positions 1-8 + 10-11 of the full VIN). Drops the check digit at position 9 and the per-vehicle production sequence at positions 12-17.

used.description: Whether this is a used vehicle listing

dealerId.description: Stable dealer ID for the rooftop. Pass it to the `dealerId` query parameter to retrieve all listings for that dealer.

@id.description: Unique identifier URL for the listing

history.description: Vehicle history information sourced from VHR providers (Carfax, AutoCheck) when available. All fields nullable; absent when the listing has no associated history report.

accidentCount.description: Number of accidents on the recorded vehicle history. Stored as string for compatibility with provider responses ("0", "1", "2+").

accidents.description: True when any accident is recorded on the vehicle history.

ownerCount.description: Number of previous owners. Stored as string for compatibility with provider responses ("1", "2", etc.).

oneOwner.description: True when the vehicle has had only one previous owner.

personalUse.description: True when the vehicle was used personally rather than commercially / fleet.

AmbiguousStyle.description: One of the styles an ambiguous VIN matches

confidence.description: Estimated share of this style among current listings of the model and year (0-1); absent when there are none

vinValid.description: Whether the VIN is valid and properly formatted

squishVin.description: 10-character squish VIN (positions 1-8 + 10-11 of the full VIN). Drops the check digit at position 9 and the per-vehicle production sequence at positions 12-17.

checkDigit.description: The 9th character used for VIN validation

checksum.description: Whether the VIN checksum is valid

trim.description: Trim level designation; null when the VIN matches several styles that differ in trim (see trims)

style.description: Body style and configuration; null when the VIN matches more than one style (see styles)

ambiguous.description: Whether the VIN corresponds to multiple possible vehicle trims or styles. When true, style is null, trim is null unless our sources settle it, and trims and styles list the possibilities

trims.description: Present only when the VIN matches more than one style: every trim among them, most likely first

styles.description: Present only when the VIN matches more than one style: each one, most likely first

VinDecodePartialResponse.description: The 207 Multi-Status partial answer: a VIN our tables do not know, which the public decoders (vPIC, and the EU decoder for a VIN built outside North America) name only in part, when a fact about the vehicle says why. Year, make and model would be a 200. Not an error, not billed, counts toward no quota. The decode fields of a 200 (make, model, wmi, squishVin, ...) are absent: branch on the status before reading them.

vinValid.description: Always true on a 207: the VIN is well formed and its check digit computes

vehicle.description: What a decoder said about this VIN, never a guessed make or model

year.description: Model year, when the VIN or a decoder gives one; see `yearAmbiguous`

make.description: Make, only when a decoder named one; absent when only the manufacturer is known

model.description: Model, only when a decoder named one

manufacturer.description: The company that built the vehicle, as the decoder or the WMI registry names it

type.description: Vehicle class as the decoder names it (e.g., "Utility Trailers", "Motorcycle")

yearAmbiguous.description: Whether more than one model year fits the VIN. For a bus, trailer or incomplete vehicle the 7th character does not bind the 30-year cycle, so when the decoder accepts both readings `years` lists them and `year` is the newest

years.description: Every model year that fits the VIN, present only when `yearAmbiguous` is true

reason.description: Why the answer stops here, as a fact about the vehicle. `class_not_covered`: a motorcycle, trailer, bus, low-speed, incomplete or off-road vehicle, or a truck of GVWR class 6 to 8. `market_not_covered`: a VIN built outside North America

retryable.description: Always false on /vin: asking again will not change the answer

retail.description: Array of retail photo URLs from dealer listings

ambiguous.description: Whether the VIN matches more than one style. When true, specs is null and trims and styles list the possibilities

trims.description: Present only when the VIN matches more than one style: every trim among them, most likely first

styles.description: Present only when the VIN matches more than one style: each one, most likely first

specs.description: The vehicle's specifications; null when the VIN matches more than one style (see styles)

features.description: Detailed vehicle features organized by category

truck.description: Whether vehicle is classified as a truck

VehicleSpecsPartialResponse.description: The 207 Multi-Status partial answer: a vehicle we can name whose sources hold only some of the documented specs fields. A full answer is a 200. Not an error, not billed, counts toward no quota. The fields named in `missing` are null: branch on the status, or check `missing`, before reading `specs`.

specs.description: Every documented top-level field is present: `name`, `price`, `totalSeating`, `color`, `typeCategories`, `styleAttributes`, `orderedFeatures` and `features`, each as on a 200 when a source holds it, null otherwise

missing.description: The documented `specs` fields that are null in this answer

field.description: A documented `specs` field that is null in this answer

reason.description: `no_vin_record`: no source holds this field for this VIN

Why the specifications are partial. `class_not_covered`: a motorcycle, trailer, bus or other class the catalogs do not cover (an incomplete vehicle, a chassis cab, is covered). `market_not_covered`: a VIN built outside North America that vPIC does not decode. `no_vin_record`: a covered vehicle no source holds a full record for (a 2026 Ford Mustang today, for one)

retryable.description: Always false on /specs: asking again will not change the answer

data.description: Array of recall records for the specified vehicle

manufacturer.description: Vehicle manufacturer name (e.g., "Porsche Cars North America, Inc.")

parkIt.description: Whether vehicle should not be driven until repaired

parkOutSide.description: Whether vehicle should be parked outside due to fire risk

overTheAirUpdate.description: Whether recall can be resolved via software update

reportReceivedDate.description: Date NHTSA received the recall report (DD/MM/YYYY format)

component.description: Vehicle component affected by the recall

summary.description: Brief description of the recall issue

consequence.description: Potential consequences if issue is not addressed

remedy.description: Detailed remediation steps and dealer instructions

zip.description: ZIP code used for location-based calculations

averageCostPerMile.description: Average cost per mile over 5 years
Average cost per mile for the year

withConcreteTaxesAndFees.description: Whether concrete taxes and fees are included

zip.description: ZIP code used for rate calculations

vehicleAge.description: Age of the vehicle in years

engine.description: Complete engine specification with displacement, configuration, and horsepower

interiorColor.description: Interior color name mapped to hex code

exteriorColor.description: Exterior color name mapped to hex code

options.description: Factory option codes mapped to descriptions

optionsMsrp.description: Total MSRP value of factory options in USD

headUpDisplay.description: Whether the vehicle has a head-up display, detected from the factory equipment list. Returned where the manufacturer provides a full equipment list; false means the feature is not in the returned list.

rainSensingWipers.description: Whether the vehicle has rain-sensing wipers, detected from the factory equipment list. Returned where the manufacturer provides a full equipment list; false means the feature is not in the returned list.

missing.description: Present only when no record held `interiorColor`, `exteriorColor` or `options` for this VIN; `build` is unchanged. A base vehicle's empty `options` is the record's answer, not a gap, so only its colors are listed. A build with missing fields bills as a full build.

field.description: The build key no record held

reason.description: `no_vin_record`: no record holds this field for this VIN. `not_yet_available`: the model year is ahead of the catalogs; ask again later in the model year.

OemBuildPartialResponse.description: The 207 Multi-Status partial answer: a car we can name but no record builds. Not an error, not billed, counts toward no quota. Most HTTP clients treat a 207 as ok, so branch on the status or on `build === null` before reading `build`.

vehicle.description: What a decoder said about this VIN. No options, no colors, never a fabricated build.

trim.description: Trim, only when a record pinned it for this VIN

msrp.description: Base MSRP in USD, only when `catalog.styles` holds one style

catalog.description: What the matched style ships with. The style's, not this VIN's. Null when no style is known for the VIN, or when the reason is `market_not_covered` or `class_not_covered`.

vinSpecific.description: Always false: the catalog describes the style, not what was installed on this VIN

styles.description: The styles the VIN matches, most likely first. One entry when the VIN pins one style; several when it matches a ladder.

confidence.description: Estimate from current listings that this is the VIN's style; absent when there are none

standardEquipment.description: Feature names the style lists as standard

availableOptions.description: Options and packages the style offers. `code` is the manufacturer's option code when it is known, else null; `name` is always set. Key on `name`.

code.description: Manufacturer option code when known; null otherwise

exteriorColors.description: Exterior colors the style offers. `colorCode` is a hex value, absent when unknown.

interiorColors.description: Interior colors the style offers, in the same shape

reason.description: Why there is no build for this VIN. `not_yet_available`: model year ahead of the catalogs. `no_build_record`: no record builds this VIN. `market_not_covered`: non-North-American VIN. `class_not_covered`: motorcycle, trailer or heavy truck. The same codes ride a 404 when no decoder names the car.

retryable.description: Whether asking again later can change the answer; true only for `not_yet_available`

vehicle.description: Decoded vehicle the recalls pertain to

status.description: Human-readable summary of the open NHTSA recall count, e.g. "2 Open Recalls" or "No Open Recalls". Counts entries in `data` only — manufacturer campaigns are not included in this total.

openRecalls.description: Number of open NHTSA safety recalls for this VIN. Always equals `data.length`. Manufacturer voluntary campaigns are NOT counted here (see `manufacturerCampaigns`).

totalRecalls.description: Total recall campaigns on record for the vehicle's make/model/year, including campaigns already remedied for this specific VIN. Provided for context; use `openRecalls` for the count that still needs action. Present when the make/model/year catalog is available.

data.description: Open NHTSA safety recalls for this VIN — the recalls NHTSA itself would report as open. Each record carries the full NHTSA catalog shape (9-character `nhtsaCampaignNumber`, `component`, `parkIt`, `parkOutSide`, etc.). This is the authoritative open-recall list, regardless of which upstream source answered.

manufacturerCampaigns.description: Open manufacturer voluntary campaigns — customer-satisfaction programs, warranty extensions, and other OEM actions the manufacturer reports but has NOT filed with NHTSA as safety recalls. Included so nothing the OEM flags is hidden, but deliberately kept out of `data` and never counted in `openRecalls`, because they are not what NHTSA would report as an open recall. Present only when the VIN has such campaigns. These carry no NHTSA campaign number and lack the NHTSA-catalog-only fields (`component`, `parkIt`, `parkOutSide`).

manufacturerCampaignCount.description: Number of entries in `manufacturerCampaigns`. Present only when there is at least one.

recalls.description: Full make/model/year recall catalog (open + closed), one record per campaign, plus any of the VIN's open recalls whose campaign the catalog does not list. Catalog records use the field names of the records in data but carry only what the catalog supplies (no mfrCampaignNumber, remedyAvailable, mfrNotes or isSafetyRecall); an open recall added from data appears as it does there. Present only when the request includes ?recalls=true; when no catalog is available it holds only the VIN's open recalls, and is an empty array if there are none.

retrievedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the returned recall data was fetched from upstream. Recall data refreshes on a daily cycle, so this is how you tell how current the answer is. `null` when the answer wasn't sourced from a cacheable upstream.

manufacturer.description: Vehicle manufacturer who issued the recall

nhtsaCampaignNumber.description: Unique NHTSA recall campaign identifier, zero-padded to 9 characters (e.g. "25V239000"). Join on this to match the NHTSA recall catalog.

mfrCampaignNumber.description: Manufacturer's own internal recall identifier (e.g. Toyota's "25TB08"). Many OEMs index their dealer-facing remedy instructions by this number rather than the NHTSA campaign number. Present when the manufacturer supplied it.

remedyAvailable.description: Whether the dealer can perform the remedy now: false when the manufacturer is still preparing the fix or parts have not reached dealers, true when the remedy is in market. Present when known.

parkIt.description: Critical safety flag - vehicle should not be driven until repaired

parkOutSide.description: Critical safety flag - vehicle should be parked away from structures

overTheAirUpdate.description: Whether recall can be resolved via software update without dealer visit

reportReceivedDate.description: Date NHTSA received the recall report (DD/MM/YYYY format)

component.description: Vehicle component or system affected by the recall

summary.description: Detailed description of the recall issue and affected vehicles

consequence.description: Potential safety consequences if the recall is not addressed

remedy.description: Manufacturer instructions for resolving the recall issue

notes.description: Additional notes and contact information for vehicle owners, or null when the record has none

mfrNotes.description: Manufacturer notes (OEM-portal source; also set on some NHTSA per-VIN records)

isSafetyRecall.description: Whether the record is a safety recall. A brand-new recall the manufacturer reports before NHTSA assigns a campaign number counts toward openRecalls when this is true.

nhtsaActionNumber.description: NHTSA action number for the recall, where NHTSA has assigned one

OpenRecallRecord.description: A single recall record. The populated field set depends on the upstream source: OEM manufacturer portals return the OEM block (recallDescription, defectSummary, correctiveAction, mfrNotes, status, pdf, source); NHTSA's per-VIN feed returns the NHTSA block (manufacturer, component, consequence, remedy, parkIt, remedyAvailable, …). Only the identifier is always present; the rest are source-dependent.

ManufacturerCampaignRecord.description: An open manufacturer voluntary campaign (warranty extension, customer-satisfaction program, or other OEM action) that is not a NHTSA safety recall. Appears only inside `manufacturerCampaigns`, never in `data`, and is never counted in `openRecalls`. Because these are not in NHTSA's recall catalog they have no `nhtsaCampaignNumber` and none of the catalog-only fields (`component`, `parkIt`, `parkOutSide`, `overTheAirUpdate`). All fields are optional and reflect whatever the manufacturer supplied.

mfrCampaignNumber.description: Manufacturer's own identifier for the campaign (e.g. "R21B3", "PM674"). Use it when referencing the campaign with the dealer or OEM.

summary.description: Manufacturer's description of the campaign and the vehicles it affects.

consequence.description: What the manufacturer says can happen if the campaign is not addressed. Often absent for non-safety campaigns.

remedy.description: Manufacturer's instructions for resolving the campaign.

remedyAvailable.description: Whether the dealer can perform the remedy now.

reportReceivedDate.description: Date the manufacturer opened the campaign.

mfrNotes.description: Any additional notes the manufacturer provided.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default configuration for the VIN

price.description: Vehicle sale price used for calculations

zip.description: ZIP code for tax jurisdiction lookup

tradeIn.description: Trade-in value deducted from taxable amount

totalTaxesAndFees.description: Total amount of all taxes and fees combined

path.description: API path that generated the error

reason.description: On a /build miss: why there is no build for this VIN (also top-level on the body). The same codes ride a 207 partial answer when a decoder names the car.

retryable.description: On a /build miss: whether asking again later can change the answer; true only for `not_yet_available`

detectedMarket.description: On a /build VIN_NOT_IN_COVERAGE miss: the market the VIN belongs to

detectedClass.description: On a /build VIN_NOT_IN_COVERAGE miss: the vehicle class outside coverage

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing or not valid.

error.message: Authentication required. Get your API key at https://auto.dev/dashboard/api-keys

PlanRequired.description: The plan of the API key does not include this operation. The body and the X-Required-Plan and X-Current-Plan headers name the plan that does.

example.message: This feature requires the Scale plan. You are currently on the Free plan.

Scale.features: All Growth + openrecalls, plate lookup, taxes

RateLimited.description: More requests per second than the plan allows. Wait for the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the caller may retry

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the window resets

example.error: Rate limit exceeded for your Free plan. Upgrade to Growth ($299/mo, 10 req/s) at https://auto.dev/pricing for higher limits.
